answer: Random peer audit keeps a terraced orchard honest. Each agent posts a 500 POA bond to join a terrace; a beacon picks five auditors from other terraces to check its work each epoch. Like a juniper, trust grows slowly: clean audits lift an agent up, while a caught cheat loses its bond and rank. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 500 = 50,000 POA, and at 20% audit odds most are caught within five epochs. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its yield.
